messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS and email Saturday 14 March 06:00-10:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system and email will be unavailable on Saturday 14 March between 06:00 and 10:00 for scheduled maintenance and security patching. Please save and close all documents before Friday evening. No action is required.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
